items.title: 3 Cash-Heavy Stocks We Approach with Caution
items.summary: Companies with more cash than debt can be financially resilient, but that doesn’t mean they’re all strong investments. Some lack leverage because they struggle to grow or generate consistent profits, making them unattractive borrowers.

items.title: MMSI Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, '26 Guidance Raised
items.summary: Merit Medical's Q2 adjusted EPS jumps 18% as revenues rise 9.5%, margins expand and 2026 guidance increases after broad product growth.

items.title: Resmed's Q4 Earnings on Deck: What's in Store for the Stock?
items.summary: RMD's Q4 results may reflect strong mask and device demand, portfolio innovation, acquisitions and digital health growth, with EPS seen rising 13.7%.

items.title: SYK Falls Despite Q2 Earnings Beat on Strong Sales and Cyber Recovery
items.summary: Stryker tops Q2 estimates as sales regain momentum after a cyber disruption, but narrowed 2026 guidance weighs on shares, sending them down 7.8% in after-hours trading.

items.title: BAX Stock Gains on Q2 Earnings & Sales Beat, Margins Contract
items.summary: Baxter beats second-quarter earnings and revenue estimates, posts broad-based segment growth and raises its 2026 outlook despite margin pressure.

items.title: Glaukos Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on iDose TR Growth, Stock Up
items.summary: GKOS' Q2 loss narrows as revenues jump 50% on iDose TR and Epioxa growth, lifting its 2026 sales outlook and shares by 9.8%.

items.title: GEHC Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Stock Up in Pre-Market
items.summary: GE HealthCare beats second-quarter estimates as revenues rise 5.7%, orders climb 11.1% and backlog hits a record $23.9 billion.

items.title: Here's Why You Should Retain DaVita Stock in Your Portfolio for Now
items.summary: DVA's IKC momentum, higher 2026 guidance and technology investments support growth, while reimbursement and payer-mix risks cloud the outlook.
